name: functions
description: Cloud Functions for Highlighting Utah (PayPal integration)
comment-on-firebase-admin: Pinned to 13.x on purpose. firebase-admin 14 removed the namespaced API (admin.firestore, admin.auth) that this file uses in ~30 places, including admin.firestore.FieldValue.increment on deposits and payments. Moving to 14 means rewriting all of that to the modular API, which is a separate job with its own testing - do not bump this to ^14 as a routine dependency update.
